title: entity.updated payload
description: State applied a proposal to one entity (contracts.md C-02 v1.6). One fact per entity; an empty changed list means the turn counted without a state change.

items.description: old is present exactly when the path existed before the change, new exactly when it exists after it (C-02 v1.6). A consumer catching up writes new when present (for a[n] with n equal to the length of the list it appends the element) and deletes the path when new is absent.

path.description: For an append the path of the element (inventory[n]), with no old. For a remove of a key the path of the key, with no new. For a remove of list elements (by value or by index) the path of the list, with the list before as old and after as new.

cause.description: Union of api-contracts.md 2.3.4 and the Causes column of state-and-mechanics.md 4.6: every cause a row of contracts.OwnershipRules allows must be publishable.
